goal: Flow run commands shall accept explicit agent work directory and runtime log options so outer agents no longer need env SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR or shell redirects. Default per-flow runtime logs shall be written under the resolved agent work directory while preserving the final JSON envelope on stdout.

analysis.problem: Outer agents currently compose commands such as env SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR=... sdd-forge flow run ... > file 2>&1 because temporary output and command capture are described as shell-level concerns. That command shape starts with env and uses shell redirection, so Codex approval prefix rules cannot reliably match stable prefixes such as sdd-forge flow run gate.
analysis.proposedApproach: Move the per-invocation agent work directory override and human-readable runtime log capture into first-class CLI options: --agent-work-dir and --log-file. Update flow command parsing, container path initialization, runtime logging, templates, generated skills, and docs so agent-facing instructions use the new options instead of env SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR or shell redirects.
analysis.validation: The approach addresses the root problem because the command line can start with sdd-forge and remain free of shell redirects while still producing inspectable logs. Existing code centralizes work directory resolution in src/lib/config.js and src/lib/container.js, and command output is emitted through src/lib/dispatcher.js, so the change has clear integration points.

knownFacts: src/lib/config.js resolveWorkDir currently prefers process.env.SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR over config.agent.workDir and .tmp.
src/lib/container.js builds paths.agentWorkDir and logDir once during initContainer, before namespace dispatchers run.
src/lib/dispatcher.js owns parsed command input, stdout/stderr writers, envelope writing, pre/post hooks, and error envelope emission.
src/lib/agent.js uses paths.agentWorkDir for ensureWorkDir, schema temp files, and provider workDirFlag injection.
src/templates/partials/core-principle.md and generated flow skills instruct agents to use SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR and shell redirection for temporary command output.
Issue #326 requires final JSON envelopes to remain on stdout while runtime logs receive progress, warnings, stderr-equivalent output, and AI call logs.
Project rules prohibit adding external dependencies and prefer removing legacy compatibility during alpha.
Explicit relative --log-file paths should resolve from the execution root so --log-file .tmp/name.log mirrors the current shell redirect location.
--agent-work-dir is a flow run public option; implementation may pre-scan raw CLI args before container initialization so paths.agentWorkDir is available early.
Runtime logs are human-readable operation logs; stdout remains the authoritative channel for the final JSON envelope.
decisionPoints: How --agent-work-dir is parsed early enough to affect initContainer path construction.
Whether --agent-work-dir is accepted only by flow run commands or by every sdd-forge command that initializes the shared container.
How --log-file defaults are named and grouped under <agentWorkDir>/logs/<flowId>/.
Which output streams and diagnostics are copied into the runtime log without corrupting stdout JSON envelopes.
How templates, generated skills, and docs are updated so outer agents stop composing env SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR and shell redirects.
How SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR tests and documentation are removed or rewritten.
resolvedByProjectRules: Do not add third-party dependencies; use Node.js built-in modules only.
Alpha policy allows removal of the SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR compatibility path instead of keeping fallback code.
Template changes under src/templates require sdd-forge upgrade so generated .agents and .claude skills are refreshed.
The final JSON envelope must remain machine-readable on stdout and must not be mixed with human-readable runtime logs.
Worktree flow implementation must stay inside the active worktree path until finalize cleanup releases it.
deferredToSpec: Exact timestamp format for default runtime log filenames.
Exact action and phase token derivation for default log filenames.
Exact runtime logger class or helper boundaries.
Exact tests for dispatcher logging, early agentWorkDir override parsing, generated skill updates, and SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR removal.

in: Add --agent-work-dir to replace SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR as the per-invocation agent work directory override.
Add --log-file and default per-flow runtime log creation for flow run command execution.
Keep final JSON envelope output on stdout.
Capture human-readable progress, warnings, stderr-equivalent diagnostics, and AI invocation log pointers in runtime logs.
Default runtime log location under <agentWorkDir>/logs/<flowId>/ for active flows and <agentWorkDir>/logs/no-flow/ when no active flow exists.
Update source templates, generated skills, AGENTS/docs references, and tests that mention SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR or shell redirect guidance.
out: Replacing the existing structured JSONL Logger format.
Changing provider profile selection semantics for SDD_FORGE_PROFILE.
Adding external logging packages or shell-based logging wrappers.

impactOnExisting: Flow command argument parsing and help text will accept new runtime logging options.
Container initialization must support an early per-invocation agentWorkDir override.
Agent invocation paths, schema temp paths, enrich dump paths, and default log paths will resolve from the new option or config.agent.workDir.
Generated flow skill instructions will stop recommending SDD_FORGE_WORK_DIR and shell redirects.
Tests covering resolveWorkDir env priority must be replaced with tests covering --agent-work-dir priority and default log behavior.

qa.question: 明示された相対 --log-file パスは、実行 root 基準と agentWorkDir 基準のどちらで解決するべきですか。実行 root は sdd-forge が対象にするプロジェクトルート、agentWorkDir は AI agent の一時ファイルとログの基準ディレクトリです。
qa.answer: 実行 root 基準で解決する。たとえば worktree root で --log-file .tmp/review.log を指定した場合は、その worktree の .tmp/review.log に書く。
qa.evidence: Issue #326 は shell redirect の代替を目的としており、現行の > .tmp/name.log は実行 root からの相対パスとして解決される。src/lib/dispatcher.js は stdout/stderr を管理し、sdd-forge CLI は root を container に登録している。
qa.why: 既存の shell redirect 運用と同じ場所に保存でき、--agent-work-dir .tmp と --log-file .tmp/name.log の組み合わせで .tmp/.tmp/name.log のような二重解決を避けられるため。

qa.question: --agent-work-dir は flow run 専用のオプションにするべきですか。それとも sdd-forge 全体で使える共通オプションにするべきですか。
qa.answer: 公開仕様としては flow run 専用にする。ただし実装では src/sdd-forge.js が raw args を早期に pre-scan し、initContainer に agentWorkDir override を渡せるようにする。
qa.evidence: Issue #326 の対象は flow run 系コマンド。src/sdd-forge.js は namespace dispatcher の import 前に initContainer を呼び、src/lib/container.js は initContainer 中に paths.agentWorkDir を確定している。
qa.why: ユーザー向けスコープを Issue どおり flow run に絞りつつ、Agent や Logger が参照する paths.agentWorkDir を container 初期化前に決定できるため。

qa.question: runtime log は人間向けの動作ログだけに限定し、最終 JSON envelope のコピーは含めない契約でよいですか。JSON envelope は sdd-forge コマンドが stdout に出す機械読み取り用の最終結果です。
qa.answer: runtime log には最終 JSON envelope のコピーを含めない。stdout の envelope を唯一の機械読み取り結果として維持する。
qa.evidence: Issue #326 は final JSON envelope continues to go to stdout と明記している。src/lib/dispatcher.js は envelope mode で JSON を stdout に書く単一箇所を持つ。
qa.why: 人間向けログと機械読み取り結果を分離し、ログ追記や警告出力で JSON envelope のパース契約を壊さないため。
